meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Provides a Python interface to bioinformatics services including UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome, QuickGO, and UniChem. Used for cross-database protein annotation, pathway retrieval, chemical identifier mapping, and integrated biological data workflows with BioServices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并整合蛋白质、基因通路、化学物等多来源生物数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要从多个生物数据库里手动拼凑蛋白或化学物信息。
copy.tagline_en: Query and merge protein, pathway, and chemical data across biology databases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often pull protein or chemical info from several biology databases by hand.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Python 调用约 40 个生物信息学服务（UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL、Reactome 等），取蛋白序列与注释、查通路、跨库转换标识符。
howto.when: 当你要在一个流程里查多个生物数据库——蛋白质、通路或化合物，或在数据库之间转换标识符时触发。单库快速查询用 gget，序列/文件处理用 biopython。

howto.what_en: Installs a Python interface to ~40 bioinformatics services (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome and others), so Claude can fetch protein sequences and annotations, look up pathways, and map identifiers across databases.
howto.when_en: Use when you query several biological databases in one workflow: protein, pathway or compound lookups, or ID conversion between them. For quick single-database lookups use gget.
